name: Treat toss
summary: A pet post as a two-second game: the pet sits on a rug, mouth open, and you pull a bone back like a slingshot and let go; the arc comes from how hard and how high you threw, so everyone sees the same catch or miss, and catches go on a board with faces.
useWhen: my dog doing the thing again
look at this cat waiting for treats
dontUseWhen: a lost pet (no game, just share it)
a group game with questions (use trivia-night)

board.description: Friends who already threw: tries, catches and a line
